notes.title: The beta testing program for Splendor Online Multiplayer will start today!
notes.content:
Dear Splendor players,

We are happy to announce that the beta testing for Splendor Online Multiplayer will start today!

To take part to the beta, please follow these steps:
[list]
[*] Right click on the Splendor application in your Library
[*] Select "Properties"
[*] Go to the "BETAS" tab
[*] Select the version named "beta_testing"
[*] Launch the game after it is updated Note that you do not need a code (this is an open beta).
[/list]

We are looking forward to read your comments on this new feature so please share your feedback using the following form:
http://www.daysofwonder.com/en/contact/splendor-beta

And please note that if bugs are welcome, feelings and kudos are appreciated as well :)

notes.title: New challenges are now available !
notes.content:
•  New Nepal Challenge Pack, with 6 brand new missions to achieve
•  Jacques Cartier Challenge Pack with 6 new missions. Requires you to be logged with your Days of Wonder account
•  Duel against 2 new characters: Francis I and Isabella of Castile
•  When you create your Days of Wonder account, you can now subscribe to our newsletter
•  You can now add bots (IA players) to your "Pass & Play" games
•  Now available in German
